claim: The European Commission takes part in Web Summit Lisbon from 10 to 12 November.
Executive Vice-President Henna Virkkunen has a fireside chat on Centre Stage on 10 November from 11:05 to 11:25, titled "Has Europe's tech moment arrived?".
HaDEA runs a workshop, "Investing in technological sovereignty: EU funding for your project", on 11 November at 15:30.
EuroHPC runs a masterclass on 11 November from 16:00 on using Europe's supercomputers, AI Factories and quantum computers for free.
EUIPO holds a panel on 11 November at 12:10 on how IP-backed finance can help companies raise money and scale.
EUIPO and INPI host an informal meetup on intellectual property for startups and creators on 12 November at 13:00.
DG GROW is at stand E415 and HaDEA at stand E418, both in Pavilion 4, and EuroHPC is at stand E405.
Four EU-funded projects join the HaDEA workshop: PERSEPHONE, RISER, AI-TranspWood and GreenChips-EDU.
The Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) organises a Dutch delegation with the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Embassy of the Netherlands in Lisbon.
The Web Summit speakers page, as read, did not list Henna Virkkunen as a speaker.
